item.description:
**Improved** - Pixel-art cursors stay sharp on Retina displays and when you resize a theme again after saving it. - Importing long cursor animations uses less memory while preserving their overall playback timing.
**Fixed** - The overlay keeps the macOS cursor visible when it cannot identify the current cursor or draw its replacement. - You can still restore the standard macOS cursors after a theme switch is interrupted.
Apple Silicon only. Curstyle is not notarized: on first launch, choose **Open Anyway** in System Settings → Privacy & Security.

Try themes before you apply them, and mix your own.
**New** - **Try it** lets you test a theme on text, links, buttons, and a map sample without changing your system cursor. - Compare up to four themes side by side, each with its own size control and a light or dark background. - Replace a single cursor with one from another theme or a GIF / PNG, with a before-and-after preview. Add cursor roles a theme is missing. - **Undo** (⌘Z) reverts saved edits one at a time, and the history survives restarts. Edits made before this version can't be undone.
**Improved** - Lower CPU use while the mouse is moving with the overlay backend. - Size fields for GIF / PNG replacements no longer save values outside 8–128 pt.
Apple Silicon only, tested on macOS 27.2. Curstyle is not notarized: on first launch, choose **Open Anyway** in System Settings → Privacy & Security.

Fixes Curstyle quitting immediately at launch in v0.1.0.
**Fixed** - The app and its helper could not find their bundled language files and crashed on startup, so nothing appeared when you opened it. If you downloaded v0.1.0, please download this version instead.
Apple Silicon only, tested on macOS 27.2. Curstyle is not notarized: on first launch, choose **Open Anyway** in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
